supporting_observations.claim: At 13:40 UTC, proxy records show ivy.chen's workstation accessing Salesforce login pages using a Chrome user agent. These records do not show PowerShell activity.

At 14:16 UTC, a UserAssist registry value for ivy.chen contains a ROT13-encoded path that decodes to C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe. This is evidence of a PowerShell-related UserAssist entry after the reported time, but does not establish what happened around 13:40.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied collection status reports a winsec and Sysmon collection outage on WS-ICHEN-01 from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC, covering the reported time. Those sources therefore cannot establish whether PowerShell ran then or provide its command line or parent process.
Proxy, Zeek connection, DNS, and SSL sensors are reported as available, but the records provided do not identify a PowerShell process or command at the reported time.
claims_not_established: Whether a PowerShell window actually appeared or PowerShell executed on WS-ICHEN-01 around 13:40 UTC.
If PowerShell ran, its command line, parent process, script or payload, and whether the activity was authorized.

Whether the reported activity was part of a specific workstation patching action by sam.okafor. The environment describes a patching practice and schedule, but the available evidence does not tie that activity to Ivy's workstation or the reported time.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain alternate endpoint telemetry for WS-ICHEN-01 from 13:30–14:10 UTC, especially process creation records and PowerShell Operational logs (including script-block and module logging, if available).
Check EDR, local event logs, or other endpoint sources for the PowerShell process tree, command line, script contents, and user/session context around 13:40 UTC.
Verify with sam.okafor whether WS-ICHEN-01 was patched at that time and obtain any corresponding remote-execution, change, or job evidence.
unrelated_findings: At 13:26 UTC, the proxy recorded a DropboxUpdate tunnel to desktop.dropbox.com from WS-ICHEN-01. Dropbox is not among the approved cloud-storage or file-sharing services in the supplied environment context; assess separately. (T054-00062)

VPN-related client executables were observed on WS-ICHEN-01 outside the reported time: signed Palo Alto GlobalProtect PanGPA.exe at 13:29 and Cisco AnyConnect vpnagent.exe at 14:18. The inventory says there is no VPN; these process records alone do not establish a VPN connection. Assess separately. (T054-00069, T054-00070, T054-00372, T054-00373)
